root_cause: Growth Swarm intelligence and calculators existed in production, but the strongest demand-generation capabilities were not yet embedded in the canonical public pages where buyers already evaluate benchmarks, knowledge loss, M&A risk, workshops and the Frisse Blik.
decision: Project Growth Swarm into existing classified website authorities instead of creating a parallel microsite: benchmark -> Friction Index, knowledge-loss page -> scenario calculator, investor/M&A -> Knowledge & Execution Risk, workshops -> anonymous cohort benchmark, Frisse Blik -> evidence-first reverse-selling promise.
prevention: Prefer existing canonical buyer-intent pages over introducing a parallel growth microsite.
Public surfaces may call only privacy-safe Growth Tools; never expose private Revenue Swarm account state.
Benchmark surfaces fail closed below the minimum sample size rather than inventing numbers.
Financial outputs remain scenario estimates and M&A outputs remain estimated risk.
A scan may recommend not buying when evidence does not justify a commercial next step.
evidence: Canonical pages selected: benchmark.html, kennisverlies-vergrijzing-mkb.html, investeerders-ma.html, workshops.html and frisse-blik.html.
Shared browser runtime uses powerhouse-growth-tools and has no private Revenue Swarm read path.
